## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] `"use client"` used only where browser APIs / hooks are needed
- [ ] No `any` types — all props and data shapes typed
- [ ] `next/image` for images, `next/link` for internal links
- [ ] `generateStaticParams` present on all `[slug]` routes
- [ ] Metadata exported from every page file
- [ ] Semantic HTML + `aria-*` attributes where needed
- [ ] Keyboard navigable, focus rings intact
- [ ] Works in both light and dark mode
- [ ] No `console.log` left in
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` values committed
- [ ] Tests added or updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No lorem ipsum or placeholder content in production paths
